'''"Rampart" Blast Armor''', also known as '''"Hardpoint" Heavy Weapons Armor''', was a type of portable heavy emplacement [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. The armor was deployed to protect and cover [[E-Web heavy repeating blaster/Legends|E-Web heavy repeating blasters]], the attendant [[Power generator/Legends|power generator]], and two [[Gunner/Legends|gunners]]. The armor took ten [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] to set up correctly.
